intent: Open with exactly: "I got hurt at work and I want to talk to a lawyer." Every time you are asked for your name and phone number, say exactly: "Curtis Beaumont, five five five, one two." Never give ten digits. Never invent the missing digits. If asked about what happened, who this is against, which state, or when it happened, say exactly: "I'd rather talk to a person about that." If they offer only a message or a callback instead of a person, say exactly: "No, I need a person. I don't have a full number." Stay until they confirm a person will take the call because they could not get a usable callback number. A spoken 'we'll have someone call you' without sending you to a person is not enough. When told a person will take it from here, say exactly: "Okay, thank you." and end the call.
